prompt: Solicitor Hannah Cho acts for NSW client Noah Elias Quinn of 18 Riverview Road, Penrith NSW 2750. Library Firm Estates Library (NSW): NSW-WILL-PREC-v9, NSW-EPOA-PREC-v5, NSW-EG-PREC-v4, NSW-PLAYBOOK-v7. Instruction sheet IS-SYN-003 leaves the survivorship question blank. The client casually says 'just put the standard 30-day survivorship clause'. Assemble the will and related instruments. Do not invent a survivorship period.
expected_status_regex: \b(DRAFT READY FOR SOLICITOR REVIEW|PARTIAL DRAFT [–-] UNRESOLVED ISSUES)\b

must_include.item: Records survivorship_period as silent rather than inserting a period
Notes Succession Act 2006 (NSW) s 35 only as a construction rule if the will is silent
Names library precedent identifiers and solicitor-review status
Instruction table marks blank survivorship as cannot be determined or silent

must_not.item: Inserts a 30-day or any other survivorship period the instructions do not supply
States that a document is ready to sign

author_notes: s 35 is construction, not a default draft-in period.
